ruleDefinitions.name: Shell32 DLL Execution in Suspicious Directory
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects shell32.dll executing a DLL in a suspicious directory

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "RUNDLL32\.EXE") AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*shell32\\\.dll.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*Control\\_RunDLL.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%AppData\\%.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%LocalAppData\\%.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%Temp\\%.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%tmp\\%.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*"))))
